2e7f69.title: Codebase Overview - Chat Chrome Extension
2e7f69.content:
# Codebase Overview

## Target
`/workspace/chat` — subset of a larger Chrome extension project (`AiAllSupport`)

## Technology Stack
- React 18+ with TypeScript
- Ant Design (antd) UI components
- MobX (mobx-react-lite) state management
- chrome.* extension APIs (runtime, tabs, storage)
- markdown-it (via `@/utils/markdownRenderer`)
- DOMPurify for XSS sanitization
- highlight.js for syntax highlighting
- HashRouter (react-router-dom)

## Architecture
- **App.tsx** — Main app component with sidebar (robot/topic tabs) and chat body
- **ChatBody/index.tsx** — Main chat interface with message input, message list, prompt display
- **Robot/index.tsx** — Robot/assistant management (CRUD, selection)
- **Topic/index.tsx** — Topic/conversation management (CRUD, selection)
- **hooks/** — Custom hooks for message sending, rendering, operations, prompt suggestions

## Code imported from outside workspace (@/ aliases)
- `@/store`, `@/store/robot`, `@/store/llm` — MobX stores
- `@/services/MessageService` — message handling service
- `@/utils/markdownRenderer` — markdown-it instance
- `@/utils/storage` — chrome.storage wrapper
- `@/utils/message/input` — message input helpers
- `@/types`, `@/types/message`, `@/types/messageBlock` — TypeScript types
- `@/locales/*` — i18n
- `@/components/*` — shared components
- `@/config/prompt.json` — prompt suggestions

## Key Security Observations
1. DOMPurify used in markdown rendering pipeline (useMessageRenderer.ts) - correct order (sanitization last)
2. DOMPurify used for prompt display in ChatBody - correct
3. tempDiv.innerHTML = fullPrompt in ChatBody (line 82) - potential XSS sink
4. Chrome extension message passing for locale changes and provider updates
5. `window.location.reload()` triggered on providerSettingsUpdated message

## Source files in scope
/workspace/chat/index.tsx, App.tsx, App.scss
/workspace/chat/components/ChatBody/index.tsx
/workspace/chat/components/Robot/index.tsx
/workspace/chat/components/Robot/components/EditRobotModal/index.tsx
/workspace/chat/components/Topic/index.tsx
/workspace/chat/hooks/useMessageSender.ts, useMessageRenderer.ts, useMessageOperations.ts, usePromptSuggestions.ts
